assertions: The response routes the request to the drugcombdb sub-skill, not drugcomb.
The response queries the canonical DrugCombDB CSV using one of load_data, search_drug_pair, search_cell_line, search, or search_batch per the drugcombdb SKILL.md API.
The response reports the canonical DrugCombDB columns Drug1, Drug2, Cell, Synergy, SynergyType, PMID.
The response applies a result limit to return a compact list of records.
The response does not use the DrugComb columns synergy_zip/synergy_bliss/drug_row/drug_col.
